description: Election Commission - Filling of a Vacancy in the Office of Member of the Moratuwa Municipal Council
categorisation: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Moratuwa Municipal Council) due to the death of an elected member, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the nomination and declaration of a new council member through an electoral process, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral matters and candidate registrations/declarations.
